name: smart-campus
description: Smart Campus Core — plataforma integrada UJAC / PTP III

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @smart-campus/api" "npm run dev -w @smart-campus/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @smart-campus/shared-types && npm run build -w @smart-campus/validation && npm run build -w @smart-campus/api-client && npm run build -w @smart-campus/api && npm run build -w @smart-campus/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @smart-campus/api && npm run test -w @smart-campus/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @smart-campus/api --if-present && npm run lint -w @smart-campus/web --if-present
